label: DS-43 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses the single-gene DefensePredictor-discovered system 43 locus cataloged as working transcriptional unit D668 and whose plasmid expression in E. coli MG1655 reduced bacteriophage plaquing.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the D668 source working identifier, the individual DS-43 gene or protein, the DS-43 HMM profile row, cloned-transcriptional-unit plaquing assays, the absent DS-43 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved DS-43 component activity and phage readouts, and other DefensePredictor-discovered or phage-defense systems.
